ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 20, 2015 and to business minors on Monday, April 27, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This section will open to Informatics Minor students on Monday, May 4, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 5 seats reserved for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 28, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
